notes: Identity assessment: supplied text identifies Is It Better to Select or to Receive? Learning via Active and Passive Hypothesis Testing, Douglas B. Markant and Todd M. Header says 2013, Vol. 142, No. 2, 000, whereas the neutral citation is 2014, 143(1), 94–122; title, authors, and DOI establish work identity, but pagination/version differs. No PDF was supplied. Only n_o is assigned. Canonical p. 12 is a plausible counterpart of published p. 105, but no unique test is specified: it reports omnibus task/training analyses, task-specific S versus R/Y1/Y2 contrasts, other pairwise contrasts, and sampling-performance correlations. These are candidate evidence only and are not selected using their numerical values. Method p. 8 reports 240 recruited undergraduates; p. 10 excludes three participants from further classification analysis, one each from RB/S, RB/Y2, II/S. Recruitment total is not assigned as target analytic N.
